method: For each function: bounded direct retail disassembly of the exact public span (no decompiler output), independent read of the installed-era source where one exists, and a fresh /GL- object compile with the unit's measured /O1 flag set compared byte by byte. Sources and quoted headers are canonical project headers under include/cl. This is source-rule evidence; the byte gate remains the only admission authority.

checks.R1: All types and declarations are canonical: UINT_PTR/FILETIME/LARGE_INTEGER and the five Win32 prototypes come from the installed PlatformSDK windows.h, and __security_init_cookie/__security_cookie/__security_cookie_complement are declared exactly once, in include/cl/crt_gs.h. The FT union and DEFAULT_SECURITY_COOKIE define live in the era crt/src/gs_support.c text this body is quoted from (SHA-256 AD03EE25...FBEE8); no local retyped layout, no duplicate declaration.
checks.R2: The two globals touched are the real /GS cookie objects: PDB data publics ___security_cookie 0x00417c44 and ___security_cookie_complement 0x00417c48, owned by gs_cookie.obj (module 29), with retail initial bytes 0xBB40E64E and ~0xBB40E64E. They are declared extern in crt_gs.h and defined once with DATA annotations in the owning dependency unit matching/cl/crt_gs_cookie.c; they are registered referents with those exact VAs, and the body's first two ordered references read/write exactly those slots.
checks.R4: Real layouts only: FT is the era source's union of unsigned __int64 and FILETIME with initializer {0}, LARGE_INTEGER is the SDK type passed to QueryPerformanceCounter, and the low/high halves are read through the SDK's dwLowDateTime/dwHighDateTime and LowPart/HighPart members. There is no offset cast, no interior-address stand-in and no type punning outside the era source's own union.
checks.R13: No class, virtual function, vtable or RTTI model appears; none of the touched SDK types is polymorphic. No vtable evidence exists and none is needed.
checks.R17: The body is the era gs_support.c text, statement for statement: the DEFAULT_SECURITY_COOKIE/high-word early-out with complement store and return, the {0} FT initialization, GetSystemTimeAsFileTime, the dwLow/dwHigh xor, the process/thread/tick xors, QueryPerformanceCounter's LowPart/HighPart xors, the DEFAULT+1 and cookie<<16 fixups, and the two cookie stores. Every statement matches a decoded retail instruction group; there are no dummy locals, volatile carriers or steering statements, and the local cookie/systime/perfctr are the values the code actually consumes.
checks.R18: Ordinary MS C89 source (a .c unit with /EHsc removed). No inline assembly, no byte array, no binary include, no padding and no decompiler paste; the body is quoted era source with its file hash and file time recorded in crt_gs.h.

checks.R1: One canonical declaration: _setdefaultprecision is declared in include/cl/crt_fp8.h from the era intel/fp8.c (SHA-256 FC1AF327...5D6B) and defined once in the unit. _controlfp_s, _invoke_watson and the _ERRCHECK/_INVOKE_WATSON_IF_ERROR inline come from the installed crt/src/internal.h; no local prototype, typedef or duplicate declaration exists.
checks.R2: The function touches no project global. Its only externals are the CRT internal _controlfp_s and _invoke_watson, reached exactly as retail reaches them (the msvcr80.dll import thunks) and registered as referents with their retail thunk VAs.
checks.R4: No structure or offset model: the body passes NULL, _PC_53 (0x30000) and _MCW_PC (0x10000) as the era fp8.c written, and the error path is the header's own inline watson call. No cast, no layout assumption.
checks.R13: No class, virtual function, vtable or RTTI appears.
checks.R17: The single statement `_ERRCHECK(_controlfp_s(NULL, _PC_53, _MCW_PC));` is the era body and expands to exactly the decoded instructions: push 0x30000, push 0x10000, push NULL, call the _controlfp_s thunk, add esp,0xC, test eax/eax, the five-NULL _invoke_watson path with add esp,0x14, pop esi, ret. The esi register carries the reused NULL constant, not a fake local.
checks.R18: Ordinary MS C89 source. No assembly, byte array, binary include or padding; the source is the installed-era file with hash and file time recorded in the header.

checks.R1: Canonical declarations only: _PVFV, the four table markers and the two runners are declared once in include/cl/crt_initsect.h and the markers defined once in the unit with their real .rtc$IAA/.rtc$IZZ section attributes. The runner's public decoration follows from the C spelling _RTC_Initialize; no duplicate or retyped declaration exists.
checks.R2: The four globals are the real PDB data publics of initsect.obj (module 52): ___rtc_iaa 0x00415c64, ___rtc_izz 0x00415c68, ___rtc_taa 0x00415c6c, ___rtc_tzz 0x00415c70, each four zero bytes in retail .rdata. They are defined here with DATA annotations and registered as referents; the two ordered references of this runner resolve to ___rtc_izz (iaa+4 equals izz in the retail sentinel layout, which is why both bounds name that one symbol).
checks.R4: Real objects only: the markers are genuine four-byte function-pointer objects laid out by their own section pragmas, and the runner walks them with typed _PVFV pointers. No offset cast, no scaled index model, no interior alias.
checks.R13: No class, virtual function, vtable or RTTI appears.
checks.R17: Decoded body and source agree exactly: push esi/push edi, the iaa+4 and izz bound loads, cmp/mov/jae, the [esi] load, null test, indirect call, add esi,4 and the cmp/jb loop, pop edi/pop esi/ret. The sentinel slot itself is not an entry, which is why the first bound is __rtc_iaa + 1; the loop bound and cursor are the real values the code uses, with no dummy locals.
checks.R18: Ordinary MS C89 source. No assembly, byte array, binary include or padding; the era initsect.c is not installed, so the body is decoded and its byte evidence is recorded in the header.

checks.R1: Same canonical header as __RTC_Initialize: one declaration of _RTC_Terminate and of the four markers, one definition each. The public decoration follows from the C spelling _RTC_Terminate.
checks.R2: The term runner references the real PDB data publics ___rtc_tzz 0x00415c70 (both bounds, since taa+4 equals tzz) owned by initsect.obj, defined once with a DATA annotation and registered as a referent. No other global is touched.
checks.R4: Typed _PVFV traversal over the real term-table sentinels; no offset cast or interior-address model.
checks.R13: No class, virtual function, vtable or RTTI appears.
checks.R17: Decoded body and source agree exactly: the same 36-byte runner over [taa+4, tzz) with the [esi] load, null test, indirect call and the typed cursor increment; all locals are the real traversal values.
checks.R18: Ordinary MS C89 source; no assembly, byte array, binary include or padding. Decoded-body provenance is recorded in the header.

The mangled spelling proves C++ linkage and a LONG __stdcall return; the source matches it, with no extern "C" mismatch and no local retyped record.

The bodies are the era atlconv.h definitions quoted with file hash and line ranges; no duplicate or locally retyped declaration exists.
